verdict.rationale: The Radeon RX 9070 XT is a discrete GPU, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a category error for this product type. HYPR-RX one-click profiles and Docker-based reproducible ROCm environments are not a versioned automation system with review or rollback, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
